colorPolicy.description: Stored color policy: currentColor rewrites fills, preserve keeps them, strip removes them. Default currentColor.

description.description: Optional collection description, up to 600 characters.

framework.description: Default export framework stored on the collection. Default svg.

iconIds.description: Catalog icon IDs to add at creation; up to 200, duplicates ignored.

namingPolicy.description: File and component naming: kebab (default), pascal, or camel.

name: create_icon_kit
title: Create Icon Collection

description: Queue a Pro Icon Collection export, including optional PNG packs. Requires an MCP token with exports:create.

collectionId.description: Numeric ID of the collection (integer or numeric string).

colorPolicy.description: currentColor rewrites fills, preserve keeps them, strip removes them. When omitted, collections carrying styling (applied style or custom icons) default to preserve; plain collections use the collection's stored policy (currentColor unless changed).

componentSuffix.description: Component name suffix, 1-32 letters or digits starting with a letter. Default Icon.

decorative.description: Mark components decorative (aria-hidden) by default. Default true.

defaultSize.description: Default component render size in pixels, 1-1024. Default 24.

formats.description: Formats to build. Defaults to the basic set: SVG folder, SVG sprite, JSON manifest, license manifest.

items.description: An export format identifier; png is shorthand for png-pack.

namingPolicy.description: File and component naming: kebab, pascal, or camel. When omitted, uses the collection's stored policy (kebab unless changed).

packageName.description: npm package name for npm-package exports, lowercase, optionally scoped.

packageVersion.description: Semver version for npm-package exports, such as 1.0.0. Default 0.1.0.

png.description: PNG pack options: sizes (up to 6 allowed pixel values, default [512]), densities (1-3, default [1]), backgroundType and backgroundColor, iconColorMode and iconColor, padding 0-256 pixels (default 48).

sizeProps.description: Emit size props on framework components. Default true.

titleProp.description: Include an accessible title prop on components. Default true.

typescript.description: Emit TypeScript where the format supports it. Default true.

name: export_icon_collection
title: Export Icon Collection

description: Render one icon as PNG or a ZIP of PNG variants. Requires the Pro Plan and an MCP token with icons:read and exports:create scopes.

backgroundColor.description: Hex background color used when backgroundType is solid. Default #ffffff.

densities.description: Density multipliers to render, up to 2. Default [1].

filename.description: Base filename for the generated file. Defaults to the icon name.

iconColor.description: Hex icon color used when iconColorMode is custom. Default #000000.

iconColorMode.description: preserve (default) keeps source colors; black, white, or custom recolor the icon.

iconName.description: The icon slug/name from the URL. Required to prevent ID-only bulk export.

padding.description: Padding around the icon in pixels, 0-256. Default 48.

sizes.description: Canvas sizes to render, up to 4 of the allowed pixel values. Default [512].

zip.description: Return a ZIP of all size and density variants instead of a single PNG. Default false.

name: export_icon_png
title: Export icon as PNG

maxIcons.description: Maximum icons in the generated collection, 1-64. Default 16.

requiredConcepts.description: Concepts that must be searched, merged with concepts extracted from the brief.

screens.description: Optional screen or page names that contribute extra concepts.

id.description: The catalog icon ID, as shown in search results and icon page URLs.

includeSvg.description: Include the raw body and wrapped SVG markup. Requires a Pro token with icons:read. Default false.

concepts.description: Optional explicit concept keywords, merged with concepts extracted from the description.

description: Remove an icon from an Icon Collection. Entry-precise by default: only the plain entry is removed and custom variants survive; set allVariants true to remove every entry of the icon. Requires a Pro API token with collections:write and mcp:use scopes.

allVariants.description: true removes every entry of the icon, including custom variants. Default false: entry-precise, only the plain entry is removed and custom variants survive.

collectionId.description: Numeric ID of the collection (integer or numeric string).

iconSetPrefix.description: Optional icon set prefix to limit the search.
